invented.quote: On a rocky stretch of coast, a lighthouse keeper's family faces the longest season of the year. Storms roll in. Supplies run low. And every night, no matter what, the lamp at the top of the tower has to be lit. Ships are counting on it, and so is everyone inside.
invented.why: The brief only says that players see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without giving details about a rocky coast, storms, low supplies, Ships counting on the lamp, or having to light the lamp every night.

invented.quote: Each day you decide who tends the light, who keeps the household going, and what you can afford to give up before the thaw.
invented.why: The brief does not describe the daily gameplay mechanics or specific decisions players make.

invented.quote: This game wasn't designed in one burst of inspiration.
invented.why: The brief does not explain how the game was originally conceived or designed.

invented.quote: families, longtime hobby gamers, and people who had never tried a cooperative game.
invented.why: The brief only states that about 60 different people playtested the game, without describing their backgrounds or gaming experience.

invented.quote: Nearly every session changed something. Rules got cut, choices got harder, and the tension got sharper.
invented.why: The brief does not mention what happened during the playtest sessions or how the rules and gameplay changed.

invented.quote: What's left is the version that kept people around the table saying "one more winter."
invented.why: The brief does not include this quote or state how playtesters reacted at the table.
The brief refers only to "the main board game ratings site" and does not name BoardGameGeek.

invented.quote: What you see on this page is what goes to the printer.
invented.why: While the user knows the art and rules are finished, neither the brief nor the user's information states that the exact contents of the page are what goes to the printer.

invented.quote: I'll post updates at every stage, including factory proofs, production photos, and shipping progress, so you always know where your copy is. If something goes wrong, you'll hear it from me first.
invented.why: The user committed to posting an update every two weeks, not to sharing factory proofs, production photos, shipping progress, or being the first to break bad news.

invented.quote: Backing on day one gets you the game at the campaign price
invented.why: The brief does not mention a special campaign price compared to a later retail price, nor any specific benefit to backing on day one.
